input: Source a vintage leather armchair for the reading nook

gold.taskTitle: Source a Vintage Leather Armchair for Reading Nook
gold.taskDescription: Find and acquire a vintage leather armchair specifically suited for a reading nook space.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this armchair?
questions.description: Understand the spending limit to narrow down sourcing options appropriately.

questions.title: What leather color are you hoping to find?
questions.description: Identify the preferred color to filter search results effectively.

questions.title: How much floor space can the armchair occupy?
questions.description: Capture the physical size constraints of the reading nook to ensure a proper fit.

questions.title: Do you prefer a specific era or style of vintage?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a particular aesthetic period in mind, such as mid-century modern, Victorian, or Chesterfield.

questions.title: Are you open to reupholstered or restored vintage pieces?
questions.description: Clarify whether the chair must be fully original or if professionally restored pieces are acceptable.

questions.title: Where are you located or willing to travel to source it?
questions.description: Establish geographic scope to determine whether to focus on local markets, national dealers, or online platforms.

questions.title: What is your timeline for having the chair in place?
questions.description: Understand the deadline or urgency to prioritize faster sourcing channels if needed.
